After the complete mean-velocity renewal B01/P85 comparison, which next direction step has enough marginal decision value: (a) one new independent instance of the unchanged five-mode comparison, (b) ending the tested mean-execution package with no more empirical work, or (c) one concrete training-change comparison for the legal feedback learner? This consultation allocates no experiment. Root has accepted P85 and specifically requested this comparison before any further pair is allocated.

The DM retains (a), narrowly over the substantive no-work alternative (b). Please challenge that recommendation on scientific decision value. The current P85 result already supports withholding mean execution as a demonstrated remedy on these fitted policies. Neither cheap execution nor the general preference for independent seeds obligates another pair.

P85 is one new matched 8401 learning instance with F/G trained normally and each final fit evaluated in sampled-velocity and mean-velocity modes, plus untuned zero-velocity H. F retains fixed stochastic half-each physical durations {1,2} at its own expiry; its complete initial duration head is frozen while actor/critic learn. G chooses every legal velocity each primitive step. Mean velocity is tanh(mu), not the expectation of a squashed Gaussian; F is still stochastic in its duration decisions. Both modes use the same fitted parameters, with fresh episode state and independently instantiated declared action streams, and evaluation does not mutate the fits.

The prospective primary F_mean−G_mean is −0.008350131013904307 (conditional evaluation SE 0.006736648533933545), WITHIN the frozen ±0.01 band. Its smaller deficit is not an absolute native gain: F_mean−H = −0.0900967755406669, G_mean−H = −0.0817466445267626, F_sampled−H = −0.04753797201899047, G_sampled−H = −0.025192576236560876. Mean−sampled is −0.04255880352167644 for F and −0.05655406829020172 for G; sampled F−G is −0.02234539578242959. All eight contrasts and their conditional SEs are in the fixed facts/summary. Four prospectively stated positive events all failed, mean Brier 0.318125; owner prediction was not taken. The result is valid complete B, not an evaluation defect, stable harm or equivalence.

The preparation's table and machine facts preserve every intervening P77–P85 outcome with its own primary. The latest node's T/F/G/H question completed at P77 with T−G and T−F losses. Fixed-{1,4} follow-ups included gains and losses; P80's F−H primary must remain distinct. Short-{1,2} P82 was WITHIN, P83/P84 were sampled F−G UP, and P84 already had both hover losses. Those gains are the strongest support for bounded short-renewal exploration, not support for mean extraction. No cross-history pooled primary, new mean/SD, best-mode score or population interval is requested.

Option (a) asks whether both adverse within-fit mode effects and the full feedback/hover pattern recur under independently learned parameters. A recurrence would strengthen ending-package advice; a reversal would reveal history dependence of these signs. Neither supplies stable superiority, and no sign would oblige another repeat. Preserve mean F−G as prospective primary, all eight contrasts and all outcomes. A further fixed-checkpoint evaluation adds conditional precision but no learning history; it is neither selected nor a preliminary gate.

Option (b) may end only the instantiated mean-execution package now. Please identify its smallest defensible boundary without turning this into all-renewal impossibility or a Portfolio lifecycle disposition.

Option (c) is concrete: a new real B compares current every-step legal feedback G with training-only scalar value-target normalization against its raw-target G version, plus H. Both receive the same information/actions/native objective and budget, with matched prospective training/reset law; primary G_normalized−G_raw and both hover contrasts. The current source already has optional decode/update/normalize hooks, left None in P85. Fixed preparation facts record question-driven library coverage and the verified official Yu et al., NeurIPS 2022 §5.1 passage supporting consideration of value-target normalization. This is a proposed training comparison, not a UAV repair diagnosis, a full MAPPO import or a claim that source availability proves correctness. It directly tests the legal null's training change, not renewal or mean extraction; it is not a competence/headroom prerequisite for another B. Judge whether this is appropriate current-family comparator development or a substantive recast, and say so explicitly.

Known work: (a) 2×512×256 training + 5×32×256 final = 303104 native steps, 2048 Adam, 160 evaluations; F head 2048000–4096000 rows / 4521984000–9043968000 dense MACs. (b) zero new empirical work. (c) 2×512×256 + 3×32×256 = 286720 native steps, 2048 Adam, 96 evaluations, no F head; normalized G adds 256 scalar-moment updates over 512 targets each. A five-mode existing-fit measurement would still cost 40960 native steps, 0 Adam and 160 evaluations. No nested policy/trajectory search, sweep or calibration experiment is proposed. Future focused changed-boundary validation is separate and reuses accepted unchanged checks.

P85 completed in 331.58 s, F 174.66877074097283 s and G including H 140.52741507801693 s; these are same-work references for (a), not future timing guarantees. Proposed complete caps are 1800 s/arm and 3600 s/invocation, supporting focused checks ≤300 s. Future wall for each possible new design stays unknown. Portable execution, if separately allocated, retains remote_first, CPU FP32/one Torch thread and fresh actual-node admission. Accepted P77–P85 resource totals only: 9 invocations/9 valid results/19 fits, 2736128 steps, 19456 Adam, 960 evaluations, 3042.26 s sum invocation wall; no pooled performance inference or study elapsed/CPU claim.
